summarization: The smartphone UI screen displays a shopping app interface. At the top, there is a navigation bar with a menu icon, the title "Featured," a search icon, and a shopping cart icon. Below the navigation bar, there is a pop-up dialog box prompting the user to "Please choose a department" with two options: "Womens" and "Plus." There is also a "CANCEL" button to close the dialog box. In the background, partially visible, are images of women's clothing, suggesting that the app is focused on fashion and apparel.
